description: This file defines the DggContainer class, which manages drawing group data, including shape indices, drawing counts, a blip store container, and option settings within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: DggContainer
classes.description: Represents a container for drawing group data, including shape indices, drawing count, blip store, options, and identifier clusters.

methods.name: getSpIdMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum shape index used in all shapes plus one.

methods.name: setSpIdMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum shape index used in all shapes plus one.

methods.name: getCDgSaved
methods.description: Returns the total number of drawings saved.

methods.name: setCDgSaved
methods.description: Sets the total number of drawings saved.

methods.name: getCSpSaved
methods.description: Returns the total number of shapes saved, including group shapes.

methods.name: setCSpSaved
methods.description: Sets the total number of shapes saved.

methods.name: getBstoreContainer
methods.description: Returns the BLIP store container object.

methods.name: setBstoreContainer
methods.description: Sets the BLIP store container object.

methods.name: setOPT
methods.description: Sets an option for the drawing group identified by a property number.

methods.name: getOPT
methods.description: Retrieves an option for the drawing group based on a property number.

methods.name: getIDCLs
methods.description: Returns the array of identifier clusters.

methods.name: setIDCLs
methods.description: Sets the array of identifier clusters.
